### Egypt's Judgment and Israel's Salvation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/egypts-judgment-and-israels-salvation
Passage: Jeremiah 46:13–28
Points:
- God directs Jeremiah to prophesy judgment not only against Judah, but against surrounding pagan powers, beginning with Egypt.
- The Lord judges both Pharaoh and Egypt’s false gods, demonstrating His supremacy over the nations.
- Although Babylon brought devastation upon Egypt and scattered the Jewish community, the judgment was not total annihilation.
- God preserves a remnant of His people, promising eventual restoration despite their history of rebellion.
- Past personal or ancestral failures do not prevent God from using repentant believers for His glory today.

### Devotional: Jeremiah 46
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/1-samuel-9-romans-7-jeremiah-46-psalm-22/
Passage: Jeremiah 46:1-28
Points:
- Ancient cultures viewed military conquest as a clash of local gods, but Israel's God rules the entire universe.
- The defeat or exile of God’s people does not signal weakness, because the Lord Himself orchestrates the rise of nations.
- Although the Lord uses foreign empires to discipline His people, He still holds those pagan nations accountable for their arrogance and conduct.
- The prophecies of Egypt's defeats at Carchemish and under Nebuchadnezzar remind believers that all earthly rulers answer to God.
